label: GB-ico-ai-data-protection-guidance What is the impact of Article 22 of the UK GDPR on fairness?

obligations.text: In most cases, for human review to be meaningful, human involvement should come after the automated decision has taken place and it must relate to the actual outcome.

Will impacted individuals be able to contest an automated decision?
For the processing to be fair and compliant with Article 22, individuals must be able to contest a decision in a timely manner.
Meaningful transparency is fundamental to support this and you must put in place the appropriate measures to ensure individuals can exercise their rights.
